# Standard Normal Plot

A function that creates a standard normal plot in R with Z T sten
stanine and percentile x axis

# Installation Instructions

## install R

installation instructions can be found here:
<https://cran.r-project.org/>\
\## install RStudio IDE (optional but a good idea)\
installation instructions can be found here:
<https://posit.co/downloads/>

open RStudio and type in the console:

    install.packages("devtools")
    library(devtools)
    install_github("sedzinfo/snp")

# Usage

    library(snp)
    standard_normal_plot()

# Package index

## All functions

- [`standard_normal_custom()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/snp/reference/standard_normal_custom.md)
  : Plot the standard normal curve with your own score scales
- [`standard_normal_plot()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/snp/reference/standard_normal_plot.md)
  : Plot the standard normal curve with score scales
- [`standard_normal_scales()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/snp/reference/standard_normal_scales.md)
  : Plot the standard normal curve with score scales at any figure size
- [`standard_normal_scales_data()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/snp/reference/standard_normal_scales_data.md)
  : Score scales of the standard normal chart, as a data frame
